name: The Morning Rush
description: Regulars at the corner café each ordered a different drink and a different pastry one busy morning. Work out who had what.
clues: Espresso goes with exactly one of Ben, Hugo, or Crimson.
Either Hugo goes with Rose or Chai goes with Hugo.
Ben goes with at least one of Chai, Cobalt, or Crimson.
Between Ben and Greta, one goes with Cobalt and the other with Rose.

hints.text: Suppose Ben went with Crimson — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Ben goes with Crimson.
Ben goes with Crimson, so it can't also go with Cobalt.
Ben goes with Crimson, so it can't also go with Rose.
…but now the clue “Between Ben and Greta, one goes with Cobalt and the other with Rose” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Ben does not go with Crimson.

hints.text: Suppose Greta went with Crimson — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.

Greta goes with Crimson, so it can't also go with Rose.
…but now the clue “Between Ben and Greta, one goes with Cobalt and the other with Rose” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Greta does not go with Crimson.
